description.sub_name: 毫微米波通訊模組分析與量測
description.sub_ename: MICROWAVE AND MILLIMETER WAVE COMMUNICATION MODULE ANALYSIS AND MEASUREMENT
description.describe_ch: 本課程為教育部補助行動通訊專業核心課程改進及推廣計畫開設課程，教材除5G應用外，亦可應用在B5G/6G及汽車自駕系統，以各種毫微米波電路模組為基礎，介紹實際無線通訊運作下之模組連接、訊號處理及系統效能間之關係及其分析、量測與評估，主要提供研究所及大四以上程度之學生進行學習, 讓學生能由淺入深漸進式熟悉毫微米波通訊模組之架構與效能,且可經由動手實做之訓練過程中獲得實務經驗。
description.describe_eh: This course is a course for the Ministry of Education's subsidy for the core curriculum improvement and promotion plan for mobile communications majors. In addition to 5G applications, the teaching materials can also be applied to B5G/6G and automobile self-driving systems. Based on various microwave and millimeter circuit modules, this article introduces the relationship between module connection, signal processing and system performance under actual wireless communication operation, as well as its analysis, measurement and evaluation. Provides study for graduate students and senior-level students, so that students can become familiar with the architecture and performance of nanometer wave communication modules, and gain practical experience through hands-on training.
